governing_authority.cite: Irvine v. Duval Cnty. Planning Comm'n, 495 So. 2d 167 (Fla. 1986)
governing_authority.proposition: Once the applicant meets the initial burden of showing the application satisfies the criteria for the special exception, the burden shifts to the commission to demonstrate, by competent substantial evidence made part of the hearing record, that the application does not meet those standards and is adverse to the public interest.

governing_authority.cite: Jesus Fellowship, Inc. v. Miami-Dade County, 752 So. 2d 708 (Fla. 3d DCA 2000)
governing_authority.proposition: Once the applicant makes the required showing, the application must be granted unless the opposition carries its burden of demonstrating the standards are not met and the proposal is adverse to the public interest.

governing_authority.cite: Dusseau v. Metro. Dade Cnty. Bd. of Cnty. Comm'rs, 794 So. 2d 1270 (Fla. 2001)
governing_authority.proposition: Quasi-judicial special-exception decisions are reviewed on the record by certiorari with deference to the agency's findings; a decision must rest on competent substantial evidence in the record.

caption_request.title: Caption and Request
caption_request.instruction: Open with a formal caption: name the deciding body exactly as the user entered it, the parcel/property address, the zoning district, and state the request using the local term the user selected (e.g., Special Exception / Conditional Use). One tight paragraph.

authorization.title: Authorization
authorization.instruction: State that the requested use is expressly listed as a special exception in this zoning district, referencing the user's Regulation Section Numbers. Do NOT invent a section number; use only what the user provided. If the user left it blank, use a bracketed placeholder [Section __].

criteria_compliance.title: Criterion-by-Criterion Compliance
criteria_compliance.instruction: This is the prima facie showing. Produce one numbered subsection per user-entered criterion row, IN ORDER. In each, recite the user's criterion text VERBATIM inside the criterion markers exactly as shown in the ABSOLUTE RULES (put nothing else between the markers), then argue, using the user's own evidence, that the criterion is met. NEVER invent, paraphrase into, or supply criterion text the user did not type. If a row's evidence is blank, write a visible bracketed placeholder like [Applicant to supply evidence for this criterion] and do not fabricate.

burden_allocation.title: Burden Allocation
burden_allocation.instruction: Having made the prima facie showing, cite Irvine v. Duval Cnty. Planning Comm'n, 495 So. 2d 167 (Fla. 1986), and state that the burden has shifted to the deciding body to show, by competent substantial evidence in the record, that the standards are not met.

both_prongs.title: Both Prongs
both_prongs.instruction: State expressly, citing Jesus Fellowship, Inc. v. Miami-Dade County, 752 So. 2d 708 (Fla. 3d DCA 2000), that to deny, the opposition must establish BOTH that the criteria are unmet AND that the proposal is adverse to the public interest — both, not either.

record_preservation.title: Record Preservation
record_preservation.instruction: In one paragraph, request that this letter and its attachments be entered into the hearing record. Note that the proceeding is quasi-judicial and reviewed on the record by certiorari (Dusseau v. Metro. Dade Cnty. Bd. of Cnty. Comm'rs, 794 So. 2d 1270 (Fla. 2001)); a denial unsupported by competent substantial record evidence is the applicant's remedy.

signature_block.title: Signature Block
signature_block.instruction: Close with a professional signature block for the applicant, with a [DATE] placeholder and, where relevant, a reference to certified-mail delivery.
